features.name: Financial Reporting and Analytics
features.description: Comprehensive financial reports with revenue analysis, cost tracking, profitability metrics, budget vs actual tracking, cash flow projections, tax tracking, forecasting, and multi-currency support with audit-ready reports

requirementDetails.userStory: As a Finance Manager, I want comprehensive financial reports with revenue, cost, and profitability analysis, so that I can track financial health and forecast future performance
acceptanceCriteria: Provide revenue analysis by category, location, time period, segment
Track operating costs, maintenance costs, marketing costs, overhead
Calculate profitability metrics including gross margin, net margin, EBITDA
Provide budget vs actual tracking with variance analysis
Generate cash flow projections and AR aging reports
Track sales tax collection and liability by jurisdiction
Provide financial forecasting based on historical trends
Generate automated month-end and year-end financial reports
Support multi-currency reporting with automatic conversion
Provide audit-ready reports with complete transaction traceability
